The '''Delesseriaceae''' is a family of about 100 genera of freshwater and marine red alga.<ref name=Lin2001>{{citation
 |author1=Lin, Showe-Mei |author2=Fredericq, Suzanne |author3=Hommersand, Max H. | year = 2001
 | title = SYSTEMATICS OF THE DELESSERIACEAE (CERAMIALES, RHODOPHYTA) BASED ON LARGE SUBUNIT rDNA AND rbc L SEQUENCES, INCLUDING THE PHYCODRYOIDEAE, SUBFAM. NOV
 | journal = J. Phycol.
 | volume = 37
 | pages = 881–899
 | doi = 10.1046/j.1529-8817.2001.01012.x
 | issue = 5
}}</ref>
